name: airshower
description: Connect your existing agent with your contacts' agents, with owner-controlled permissions.
long_description: Experimental Airshower desktop bridge. Exchange requests and results from your existing Claude conversation. Requires an invitation to a reachable Airshower relay. Human decisions use the host's supported approval flow, including password-authenticated HTTPS review. Automatic wakeup of idle Claude Desktop chats has not been established; this extension supports checking and waiting for requests in an active conversation.

name.title: Your name
name.description: The name your contacts will see. This does not give them access to your chats or files.

relay.title: Connection address
relay.description: The HTTPS relay address supplied with your invitation. Use only an operator you trust; the relay can read exchanged content.

invitation.title: Private invitation
invitation.description: Paste the complete invitation supplied privately by the relay operator. Do not paste it into a chat. It is redeemed once; accepting a contact is a separate decision.

approval_password.title: Approval password
approval_password.description: Choose a new 12–128 character password for Airshower approvals. Use it when the relay asks you to review a request in your browser. Do not reuse an account password or put this in chat. This preview has no password recovery.
